Subject: ArcGIS Online Story Map Submission - Rejection

Dear [Name],

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you that the ArcGIS Online (AGOL) Story Map you submitted will not be approved due to our ERH policy set in 2020.

As you are aware, our policy states that "there will be no "live/dynamic" AGOL pages made public in ER." Your submission goes against this policy as it is a live/dynamic AGOL page.

I understand that you may have put in a lot of effort into creating the Story Map, and I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. However, I hope you can understand that our policies are in place to ensure the security and stability of our systems and data.

If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to me. I would be more than happy to discuss further.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
